title: The best so far may be too early
hook: Learning the standard can cost the chance to choose the person who set it.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
Offline optimum versus online decisions; cost and approximation ratio.
doesNotKnow: Reject an initial sample then accept the first record afterward, with no returning to rejected choices.

misconception: An online selector can inspect everyone and still choose an earlier rejected item.
objective: Reject an initial sample then accept the first record afterward, with no returning to rejected choices.

claims.text: The rejected prefix establishes a record but cannot be recalled. The policy accepts the first later candidate exceeding that record; it does not wait to compare all candidates. Enumeration reports this exact four-candidate success count, not an asymptotic rate.
